# CODEOWNERS Shadow Checker

> Free tool: paste your CODEOWNERS file and your repo's file list to see exactly which earlier, more specific rules a later, broader rule silently overrides -- GitHub's own last-match-wins resolution, the most common way a CODEOWNERS file quietly stops reviewing what you think it reviews. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
